_comment: The container profile, switched on by the image (I2K_PROFILE=container) and never on a Mac. Read on top of
playbook.default.json and playbook.local.json, and it wins over both.
A Linux container has no Metal graphics, so every Apple-only part is replaced by the one the program already
offers on other systems: faster-whisper on the CPU for the transcript, Tesseract for board text and scanned PDF
pages. The model hosts are reached by URL: host.containers.internal is the machine that runs the container (its
LM Studio or Ollama); a worker set or a model's baseUrl can name any other host, as on the Mac.
